# The central laws over every relation of exchange

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`central-laws-over-every-exchange` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](central-laws-over-every-exchange.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Each of the 33 central laws taking balance, only active giving or taking, or activity needing support holds over what is read off an exchange, those premises discharged by the reading; what stays a hypothesis is a state of the law or the law's own.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Over every world with its rest counted: balance and the two activity premises hold by the reading, so every central law needing no more holds with no premise, and the rest theorem reads the census off the exchange where a named family closes each step; under balance the rest exchanges nothing and the world's relata are as they were. (`Becoming.World.withRest_acting`, `Becoming.World.withRest_all_end`, `Becoming.World.withRest_closed_lineage_lowered`, `Becoming.World.withRest_comes_to_rest_unrefuted`, `Becoming.World.withRest_counterfactual_is_course`, `Becoming.World.withRest_lineage_ends`, `Becoming.World.withRest_opens`, `Becoming.World.withRest_renewedBy`, `Becoming.World.withRest_replenishes`, `Becoming.World.withRest_replenishment_unbounded`, `Becoming.World.withRest_rest_idle`, `Becoming.World.withRest_restores`, `Becoming.World.withRest_retains_iff_within_margin`, `Becoming.World.withRest_rises_iff_inactive`, `Becoming.World.withRest_some`, `Becoming.World.withRest_taking`, `Becoming.World.withRest_unexcluded_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.World.withRest_unselected_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.World.withRest_unselected_beyond_pool`, `Becoming.World.withRest_uptake_needs_replenishment`, `Becoming.World.withRest_widens_iff_others_within`)
2. Over every two worlds of one kind of relatum with their rests counted: the comparisons of two courses hold with balance discharged in both, under every law of exchange over the relata with the rest. (`Becoming.World.withRest_act_selected_by_pool`, `Becoming.World.withRest_act_unselected`, `Becoming.World.withRest_apart_only_downstream`, `Becoming.World.withRest_comparison_within_response`, `Becoming.World.withRest_present`, `Becoming.World.withRest_start`, `Becoming.World.withRest_widening_selected_by_pool`)
3. Over every world read off a relation of exchange, its flow a run along its standings and each requirement a necessary response of its exchange: activity needs support with its rest counted, so the central laws needing it hold with no premise. Every run of every relation and the course of every law are such worlds; a world whose relatum exchanges unsupported is not. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWorld_readOffExchange`, `Becoming.ExchangeRelation.Runs.readOffExchange`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.consumption_ends_with_feeders`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.continuing_excludes`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.coupled_end_together`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.dependent`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.family_childless`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.family_excess_ends`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.outrun_below`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.roles_dependent`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.selected_le`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.selection_within`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.support_moved_rises`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.support_not_lower`, `Becoming.World.ReadOffExchange.transmitted_supported`, `Becoming.World.takingUnsupported`, `Becoming.World.takingUnsupported_not_readOff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own hypotheses and the states of the law it takes (dissipation, embodiment, bounded transmission, enclosure, feasibility, a census of what stands); the forms over a world read off a relation take that reading.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That every becoming has a law or relation of exchange whose readings these are: discrete steps and natural-number amounts stay commitments of the representation.
- Which law of exchange holds, or whether it meets the states the laws take.
- The laws over the world's own relata where closure fails: there the rest is a relatum the laws count, a giver or a feeder.
- The warrant of locality, on which reading requirement as necessary response rests: necessary response is the weakest local reading under which activity needs support (requirement-is-the-weakest-sound-reading); read as possible response, activity needing support fails.
- **Counterexample:** World.takingUnsupported: a world whose relatum takes a unit from itself at every step while standing at nothing and requiring itself at need one is read off no relation of exchange (takingUnsupported_not_readOff). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OverExchange.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
